invscale.title: InvScale
invscale.subtitle: Independent GUI & HUD scaling
invscale.mode.relative.desc: Scales multiply your GUI Scale. 1.00x always looks exactly like vanilla.
invscale.mode.absolute.desc: Scales are exact pixel sizes, like picking a GUI Scale number (4.00x = GUI Scale 4), no matter what your GUI Scale option is.
invscale.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, everything looks exactly like vanilla.
invscale.option.pixel_snap.tooltip: Rounds inventory and container sizes to whole pixels for perfectly crisp text and textures.
invscale.option.high_res_items.tooltip: Renders item icons at a higher resolution when they are shown bigger than normal, instead of blowing up small icons.
invscale.option.modded_screens.tooltip: Also apply the Container Scale to container screens added by other mods.
invscale.option.custom_hotbar.tooltip: When off, the hotbar is drawn exactly like vanilla.
invscale.option.bars_follow.tooltip: Health, hunger, armor, XP and item names stay on top of the hotbar when you resize or move it. Their own size is not changed by the hotbar scale.
invscale.option.hud_scaling.tooltip: When off, the HUD Scale above is ignored (per-element scales still apply).
invscale.option.element_enabled.tooltip: Customize this element. Off = vanilla (ignores HUD Scale, offsets and hiding).
invscale.option.element_scale.tooltip: Element scale, multiplied by the HUD Scale.
invscale.overview.gui_scale: Your GUI Scale: %s (never changed by InvScale)
invscale.hint.general: Every change applies instantly. InvScale never touches Minecraft's own GUI Scale option, and it is purely visual: no packets, no gameplay changes.
invscale.hint.hotbar: Tip: while you drag a slider the menu fades out so you can see the real hotbar.
invscale.hint.override: Far left = Default (follows the scale above). Sizes that don't fit your window are reduced automatically.
invscale.hint.elements: On/Off customizes an element, Shown/Hidden hides it, the slider sets its size.
invscale.hint.positions: Elements always stay on screen, and Reset Position puts them back. Drag a slider to see the HUD clearly.
invscale.hint.element_disabled: This element is set to vanilla in the HUD tab, so offsets have no effect.
invscale.hint.profiles: The "Toggle Between Profiles" key swaps between these two presets.
invscale.hint.keybinds: All keys can be changed in Options > Controls > Key Binds > InvScale.
invscale.button.reset.tooltip: Resets the settings on this tab to their defaults (click twice).
invscale.button.apply.tooltip: Saves to config/invscale.json now. Changes are already live and are also saved when you close this screen.
invscale.button.test_inventory.tooltip: Opens your inventory with the current settings.
invscale.button.save.tooltip: Save the current settings under the name above. Saving over a built-in preset stores your own version of it.
invscale.button.rename.tooltip: Rename the selected preset to the name above.
invscale.button.delete.tooltip: Delete the selected preset. Built-in presets can't be deleted.
invscale.button.reset_preset.tooltip: Built-in: undo your edits to it. Your own preset: reset it to Default values.
invscale.hud.title: Titles
invscale.preview.title: Preview: %s
invscale.preset.error.builtin_rename: Built-in presets can't be renamed - save a copy instead
invscale.preset.error.exists: A preset with that name already exists
invscale.command.disabled: InvScale disabled - everything is vanilla now.
invscale.command.status: Preset: %s | Hotbar %s | Inventory %s | Containers %s | HUD %s | Mode: %s
